attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":1,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The bulletin copies the briefing's section labels ('News since your last bulletin:', 'Already reported:') as headings, which breaks character. It recycles the earlier bulletins' jokes almost verbatim ('asking politely that no one follow them', the arithmetic line, 'Last Lantern apparently is'), and it presents Fenwick's razing as fresh news again. It also falls under the 80-word minimum."}
